injuries.name: Nate Schmidt
injuries.note: The Mammoth indicated Monday that Schmidt was considered out indefinitely, and he was officially placed on injured reserve. It isn't particularly surprising to see him labeled as week-to-week, and it indicates that he's unlikely to return after spending the minimum amount of time on IR. It seems likely that the 35-year-old will be sidelined until at least late November.

injuries.name: Thatcher Demko
injuries.note: Demko missed the second half of the 2025-26 season after undergoing hip surgery in January, and he was officially placed on injured reserve last week. He doesn't yet have a clear timetable for when he'll be back in action, but Sedin said that Demko is "taking steps every day" in his recovery process. While Demko is sidelined, Kevin Lankinen and Leevi Merilainen should compete for starts in the Canucks' crease.

injuries.name: Logan Cooley
injuries.note: Upper Body: Cooley is OUT for Saturday's (Nov. 14) game versus the Sharks and could be out longer than that, per Ben Anderson of KSL Sports.

injuries.name: Artem Duda
injuries.note: Lower Body: Duda will be a game-time decision against the Vancouver Canucks on Monday, per Brogan Houston of the Deseret News.

injuries.name: Dylan Guenther
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Utah Mammoth placed F Dylan Guenther on injured reserve on Wednesday (Nov. 11).

injuries.name: Maveric Lamoureux
injuries.note: Shoulder: The Utah Mammoth placed D Maveric Lamoureux on injured reserve and will miss 4-6 months following surgery to repair a dislocated shoulder.

injuries.name: John Marino
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Utah Mammoth placed D John Marino on injured reserve on Sunday (Nov. 1).

injuries.name: Nick Schmaltz
injuries.note: Lower Body: The Mammoth said on Saturday (Nov. 14) that Schmaltz's status is unclear when he will be ready to return, per Brogan Houston of the Deseret News.

injuries.name: Nate Schmidt
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Utah Mammoth said on Thursday (Nov. 12) that Schmidt is considered week-to-week, per Cole Bagley of KSL Sports.

injuries.name: Guillaume Brisebois
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Vancouver Canucks placed D Guillaume Brisebois on injured reserve on Friday (Nov. 13).

injuries.name: Thatcher Demko
injuries.note: Hip: The Canucks placed Demko on injured reserve and hopeful he will be ready to return before Christmas, per Kevin Woodley of NHL.com.

injuries.name: Mackenzie MacEachern
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Vancouver Canucks placed F Mackenzie MacEachern on injured reserve non-roster.
